blurb: Hill Top Equestrian Center aims to help kids realize their value through the love and power of Jesus Christ. They offer equestrian activities and events such as dressage, hunter, and combined tests. The center is supported by Jacob's Well Fellowship, an interdenominational Christian volunteer group.
